Loops, Session 12

The one idea to landA while loop has three controlling lines in three different places, the initialization before it sets the counter, the termination condition on the loop line is asked again before every pass, and the updation inside the body changes what that condition looks at. Miss the first and the program stops with an error; get the second wrong and it runs the wrong number of times, or none at all; miss the third and it never stops.

Hook: forty copies, and where else

Hook: forty copies, and where else

Programming Foundations · Session 12

Forty Copies

He types 40, presses START once, and walks away. But the machine only knows how to make one copy. So what is going on inside it, forty times over?

One press, and a machine repeats the same small job until it has done it enough times. Where else have you seen that? Say the machine, and say the one job it repeats.

The ATMpushes out one note, again, and again, until it reaches the amount you asked for.
The attendance SMSsends the same message to one parent, then the next, until it has gone down the whole list.
The liftclimbs one floor, checks whether it has arrived, climbs one more, until it is at your floor.

Hands-on: type it, then break it

Hands-on: type it, then break it

While Loop

Type It, Then Break It

Type this into the playground exactly as it is. The first line asks for a. Give it a = 5 and run. Then run it again with a = 1, and again with a = 100.

a = int(input())
counter = 0
while counter < 3:
    a = a + 1
    print(a)
    counter = counter + 1
print("End")

Two changes to the same program, in this order.

1

Delete the line counter = counter + 1, then run it again with a = 5. The stop button sits beside Run. You are going to need it.

2

Put the line back. Now move it above print(a) and run with a = 5 again. What changed, and what did not?

Common Mistakes and Errors

Find the Mistake

Worksheet task 3. Three programs, and every one of them is broken. Say which line, which part, and what happens. Worksheet tab only: do not run them.

  • Which line is wrong, or, if the problem is that something is not there, what is missing and where it should go.
  • In the table, write which part it is, initialization, termination condition, or updation.
  • Then write what happens when you run it, in your own words. An error message, a wrong number of lines, or no stop at all.

Three minutes. Then we go through these three and the one you broke yourselves, four in all. Program 1 has input 5. Program 2 has input 10. Program 3 has input 1.

While Loop

Before You Go

A name-board app prints one letter of a name per line. Somebody types a single letter: R. What appears on the screen?

1  a = input()
2  counter = 0
3  length_of_a = len(a)
4  while counter < (length_of_a - 1):
5      print(a[counter])
6      counter = counter + 1
  • R
  • nothing at all
  • IndexError: string index out of range
  • R, over and over, forever

2: nothing at all. len("R") is 1, so line 4 asks 0 < 0, which is False the very first time. The body never runs once.counter = 0length_of_a = 1while 0 < (1 - 1): False print(a[counter]) counter = counter + 1Nothing on screen, and nothing wrong with the machine.
